entities.name: Jasmine Boreal
entities.description: A legendary human druid who briefly joined the Robaran Circle of Seven.

entities.name: Robarans
entities.description: A mercenary group led by Adira Strongheart.

entities.name: Adira Strongheart
entities.description: Leader of the Robaran Circle of Seven.

entities.name: Hazezon Tamar
entities.description: A Robaran who used "Jewels of Jasmine!" as a curse.

entities.name: Heath
entities.description: A half-elf, half-Radjan Spirit scout of the Robarans who became Jasmine's lover.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: Leader of an army defeated at the gates of Palmyra.

entities.name: Shauku
entities.description: A vampire whose castle dungeons held the Robarans.

entities.name: Arboria
entities.description: Pineland forest where Jasmine stayed with the pinefolk.

events.summary: Jasmine joins the Robarans some months after Johan's army is defeated at Palmyra.
events.quote: Jasmine Boreal joined the Robarans and Johan's War

events.summary: Jasmine and Heath become lovers during their ship voyage in Buzzard's Bay.
events.quote: They eventually became lovers during their ship voyage in Buzzard's Bay .

events.summary: Jasmine recounts the history of the pinefolks to the Seveners upon reaching Arboria.
events.quote: it was Jasmine who recounted how the land was once inhabited by pinefolks

events.summary: Jasmine casts Earthquake in the dungeons of Shauku's castle, disabling the vampire so the Robarans escape.
events.quote: which temporarily disabled the vampire , permitting the Robarans' escape

events.summary: Jasmine quits the Robarans to remain with the pinefolk of Arboria and learn from their shaman.
events.quote: decided to quit the Robarans Mercenaries to remain with the pinefolks of Arboria

relations.quote: She was, for a short time, a member of the Robaran Circle of Seven
Robaran Circle of Seven of Adira Strongheart
